parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database that you want to query.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the tenant ID, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise update-data-lake-function --catalog-name hive --db-name default --function-input example-string --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --workspace-id 120000 --function-name my_funciton --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise UpdateDataLakeFunction --region cn-hangzhou --FunctionName my_funciton --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --DbName default --FunctionInput 'example-string' --Tid 3000 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
